name: God Will Not Save You
source:
A group of young adults are on a summer road trip to discover themselves, however a strange run in with an antique shop ends it short. They are suddenly transported into a new and unwelcoming world where they are forced to adapt, survive and escape in order to get back to their own bodies and lives. 

[From [url=https://asani-onyx.itch.io/god-will-not-save-you]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一群年轻人踏上夏季公路旅行，寻找自我，然而一次与古董店的奇怪邂逅却让一切戛然而止。他们突然被传送到一个新的、不受欢迎的世界，在那里他们被迫适应、生存和逃离，以便回到自己的身体和生活中。

[来自[url=https://asani-onyx.itch.io/god-will-not-save-you]Itch.io[/url]]
